{{Quote|It's what the smelter used that day.|Emperor Palpatine to Bevel Lemelisk, after he wondered why molten copper was used for his execution|<ref name="Darksaber (novel)">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
[[File:CheapCopperBattery.jpg|200px|thumb|A cheap copper battery which could provide power to many types of electronic devices.]]
'''Copper''' was an element that could be mined throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Chalcopyrite/Legends|Chalcopyrite]] and [[malachite]] were both copper-based [[Ore/Legends|ores]].<ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

It was a byproduct of the seas of [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] with the cities of the [[Copper Coast]] often covered with a coppery fog composed of sea spray and chemicals that could harm the skin of sensitive species.

One of [[Bevel Lemelisk]]'s many executions was being dipped in molten copper, largely because it was what the smelter was using that day.

Copper [[Phthalocyanine Blue]], a type of copper variant, was mixed with [[4-Dimethylaminobenzene]] to produce the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] variant [[Booster Blue]].

[[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] was said to have significant deposits of copper.<ref name="DF:JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Aii`tkian Anthropologists]] and the [[O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild]] discovered a new strain of copper in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]'s [[Area D-502]]. Aii`tkian scientists then investigated whether it could be used by local [[starshipwright]]s, such as [[Tenna Ghii'anna]], to manufacture [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts.<ref name="SWG:IDN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Imperial Daily News}}</ref>
